interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at intersections or mid-block locations to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Speed humps or cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Narrow the roadway at crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections or mid-block crossing points to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a landscaped buffer or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Adding street lamps along the sidewalk would improve visibility and the sense of security for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to physically reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during dawn, dusk, and nighttime.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: If this is a frequent crossing point, install a high-visibility marked crosswalk to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Vegetation Maintenance
interventions.description: Regularly prune hedges and low-hanging branches to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Intersections
interventions.description: Remove parking near intersections to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add a center line or edge lines to better define travel lanes and organize traffic flow.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Clear debris and ensure a level walking surface to prevent trips and falls.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Realignment
interventions.description: Reconstruct the sidewalk to curve around the tree or widen the walkway to ensure a minimum clear path of 4 feet is maintained.

interventions.title: Sightline Improvement
interventions.description: Trim low-hanging vegetation near the driveway to improve visibility between motorists and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to physically enforce low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential neighborhood.

interventions.title: Roadway Markings
interventions.description: Apply standard center line and edge line markings to better define the travel lanes and encourage predictable driving behavior.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk's material and elevation across the driveway to reinforce pedestrian priority and encourage slower vehicle turns.

interventions.title: Raised Driveway Crossing
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk level and material across the driveway to signal pedestrian priority and slow entering/exiting vehicles.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the driveway apron to provide a smooth, level transition for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim back overhanging or dense vegetation near the driveway entrance to improve visibility for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven sections of the concrete walkway to ensure an accessible and hazard-free path.

interventions.title: Street Trees/Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or additional street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.
